assumptions: Ordering uses immutable server timestamp plus ID. Authorization and follow-graph revisions scope cached results; hydration removes deleted or forbidden posts.
Publishing is derived from a durable transactional post outbox/CDC stream. Stream replay is bounded; expired positions explicitly reset.
Reference tests model bounded mechanisms; they do not qualify production concurrency, failure recovery or latency.

The follower distribution is the design driver: most accounts are small, a few are enormous. [Publish–subscribe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Publish%E2%80%93subscribe_pattern) separates producing an update from distributing it to interested consumers. Delivery cost shifts depending on whether work is performed when writing or when someone reads.

stages.explanation: Requirements: users post, follow accounts, and read a fresh home feed. A retried post with the same clientId returns the same tweet. The follower distribution is the design driver: most accounts are small, a few are enormous. [Publish–subscribe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Publish%E2%80%93subscribe_pattern) separates producing an update from distributing it to interested consumers. Delivery cost shifts depending on whether work is performed when writing or when someone reads.

stages.explanation: Pull-to-refresh repeats the same merge many times a minute. A cursor taken from an older first page continues without repeats. A short per-user cache absorbs refresh storms; the keyset cursor keeps continuation correct even from a stale first page. [A cursor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cursor_%28databases%29) records where a query should continue. Its ordering fields must distinguish equal values, and its validity depends on the query and access permissions.
